coverage: Conversations Merri-bek alerts since 27 Jan 2026, live Coburg projects, council news and notices, PlanningAlerts applications within about 2 km; PlanningAlerts API (2 km radius); Transport Victoria service alerts; state planning scheme amendments

projects.name: Harmony Park risky play
projects.what: New ‘risky play’ area alongside the existing junior and senior playspaces: climbing, bouldering, crash nets, fast slides, balance and nature play are on the table. Draft concept consultation ran 31 Aug–28 Sep.
projects.when: Detailed design Nov–Dec 2026, construction Apr–Jun 2027, opens end of June 2027.
projects.why: Closest playground project to Ryan St, built for primary-school-age kids and an easy walk.

projects.name: Duggan Reserve playground
projects.what: Park and playspace upgrade: new play equipment, seating, a small shade structure, planting and paving. Small local park, so no toilets, lighting or large equipment; dog-on-lead.
projects.when: Draft concept for feedback late Jan–Feb 2027, construction late Apr–Aug 2027, reopens around 20 Aug 2027.
projects.why: Bikeable along the Merri Creek trail. Worth a look at the draft concept in late January.

projects.name: Mitchell Reserve playground
projects.what: Park and playspace upgrade. Can influence play equipment, seating, a small shelter, planting, paving and public art. No lighting, toilets or large equipment.
projects.when: Concept consultation 28 Jan–28 Feb 2027, construction May–Oct 2027, reopens 11 Oct 2027.

projects.name: Hallam Reserve park & playground
projects.what: Playspace upgrade (may move to the south-west corner) plus seats, paths, a possible picnic area and fitness station.
projects.when: Infrastructure works Feb–Apr 2027, playspace works Jul–Nov 2027.

projects.name: Tony Mommsen Reserve
projects.what: New play equipment and park furniture. Delayed to work through schoolchildren crossing the reserve from the neighbouring primary school.
projects.when: Construction Apr–Jun 2027, reopens June 2027.

projects.name: Glenroy Lions Park
projects.what: Park and playspace refresh using phase 1 feedback; pop-up in the park with the draft plan.
projects.when: Construction in the 2027–28 financial year.

projects.name: Methven Park play equipment
projects.what: Like-for-like replacement of two play structures removed for safety. Heritage elm avenue protected.
projects.when: Installed from 1 Sep, reopened mid-September 2026.

projects.name: Aspire Sports Centre
projects.what: Bachar Houli Foundation building a multipurpose indoor centre on the former Coburg-Moreland bowls club site: 2 indoor courts in stage 1 (third if funded), high-performance gym, and the Islamic College of Sport (Years 11–12, up to ~200 students). Council keeps the land; community access via a booking schedule. Merri Community Shed and Coburg Commons need relocating.
projects.when: Traffic and parking study underway. Could open around 2028.
projects.why: 1.2 km away. More indoor court time in Coburg (Coburg Basketball has waitlists), and extra traffic around Harding St and the Coburg Lake end.

decision.text: Council report on Aspire Sports Centre lease and community access (late 2026)

projects.name: Joe Luppino Grandstand naming
projects.what: Proposal to name the Coburg City Oval grandstand after the late Joe Luppino, council's long-time recreation manager.
projects.when: Report to Council in 2027.

decision.text: Report to Council on naming the Coburg City Oval grandstand (2027)

projects.name: Lorne Street Reserve disc golf trial
projects.what: Free temporary disc golf course with removable baskets, run with Melbourne Disc Golf Club. Feedback decides whether it becomes permanent.
projects.when: Runs to January 2027, daylight hours.
projects.why: Free, low-key family activity a short ride up the Merri Creek trail. Bring a frisbee before it ends in January.

projects.name: Fawkner netball roof & courts
projects.what: $4.561M federally funded roof over 4, 6 or 8 netball courts with solar, plus resurfacing all 8 courts.
projects.when: Works Oct/Nov 2026 to May/Jun 2027.

projects.name: Dunstan Reserve lighting & sportsground
projects.what: Four new LED light poles over the south open space (former athletics field), then rebuilt south ground with drainage and irrigation.
projects.when: Lighting done by Feb–Apr 2027. South ground closed from Aug 2027, reopens around May–Jun 2028.

projects.name: Brunswick Parklands precinct
projects.what: Heritage grandstand restoration, LED oval lighting, two netball change rooms, stormwater harvesting at Reaburn Reserve (24.4 ML a year), and Victoria St protected bike lanes.
projects.when: Works roughly Jan–Jul 2027.

projects.name: JP Fawkner sportsground upgrade
projects.what: Regrading, drainage, irrigation, new turf and cricket/football facilities on both ovals.
projects.when: Builder July 2027, works from Aug 2027, handover Apr–May 2028. Playground stays open.

projects.name: Blair Street school precinct
projects.what: Two options for the school frontage. Option 1: Blair St one-way eastbound (bikes both ways), 20 km/h shared zone, protected area with seats, trees, bike parking and play space. Option 2: stays two-way with narrowed lanes and a smaller protected area. The 18 angled parks out front go either way. De Carle St and Moreland Rd get 2-minute drop-off (8–9am, 3–4pm) and 10-minute parking on school days.
projects.when: Pop-ups Thu 19 Nov 3–6pm and Fri 20 Nov 7:30–9:30am. Detailed design early 2027, construction mid-2027.
projects.why: Council's first 'school precinct' pilot; the same model may later come to other schools around Coburg.

projects.name: Aquatics & Leisure Strategic Plan
projects.sub: Coburg, Brunswick, Fawkner, Oak Park, Pascoe Vale
projects.what: Four-year plan for programs and services at the leisure centres, now run by Belgravia Leisure (from July 2026). Feedback shapes programs, days and times, not fees, hours or capital works.
projects.when: Final plan 30 Nov 2026.
projects.why: If you want different kids' swim or class times at Coburg Leisure Centre, this is the window to say so.

decision.text: Aquatics and leisure strategic plan finalised

projects.name: Festivals program refresh
projects.what: Proposed: Coburg Night Market and Sydney Road Street Party move to every second year; Fawkner Festa and Glenroy Festival fold into a new multi-day festival across the north (including Coburg in off years). Brunswick Music Festival stays annual. Carols by the Lake at Coburg Lake unchanged.
projects.when: Council decision February 2027.
projects.why: Changes how often the Coburg Night Market runs. Carols by the Lake is safe.

decision.text: Council to endorse festival changes, incl. Coburg Night Market every second year (Feb 2027)

projects.name: Tree for Me
projects.what: Tree-planting pilot at Moomba Park Primary and Levande Gowanbrae. For households: council's Tree Finder tool suggests species for front or back gardens, narrow spaces and planters.
projects.when: Expansion depends on a state grant.

projects.name: Human Rights Policy 2026–2036
projects.what: Ten-year policy plus Gender Equality, Social Cohesion, Disability Access and LGBTQIA+ Inclusion plans.
projects.when: Final policy to Council 9 Dec 2026.

projects.name: Calder Reserve park & playspace
projects.what: Park and playspace upgrade with a final design locked in after two rounds of feedback. The old light pole goes; no toilet, BBQ or shade sail (trees instead). Dog-on-lead.
projects.when: Construction Oct 2026 to end Jan 2027, reopens February 2027.
projects.why: 1.6 km away and closed this summer. Back open in February.

projects.name: James Reserve
projects.what: New play equipment, seating, paths and landscaping. Council is also exploring a 12-month trial closure of Dromana Ave North and/or Norton St West to join the reserve's three pieces into one.
projects.when: Final concept early 2027, construction mid-2027.

projects.name: Wetlands & swales
projects.sub: Austin Cres Reserve, Pascoe Vale + Jacana Valley, Glenroy
projects.what: New stormwater wetlands at Fran Street and Moonee Boulevard reserves (Jacana Valley, Glenroy) and a planted swale at Austin Crescent Reserve, filtering runoff before it reaches Moonee Ponds and Westbreen creeks.
projects.when: No construction dates published yet.

projects.name: Balfe Park sportsground
projects.what: Flood fix and rebuild of the oval used by Brunswick Zebras: regrading, sand-profile drainage, irrigation, new turf, goal netting and a granitic path. Paths and the rest of the park stay open.
projects.when: Closed from Aug 2026, reopens around May–Jun 2027.

projects.name: Post Office Place streetscape
projects.what: Making the Glenroy shopping street safer, greener and more welcoming: lighting, sight lines, planting and seating. Part of the Places for People plan.
projects.when: Draft concept consultation closed Sept 2026; final design next.

projects.name: Fortnightly rubbish collections
projects.what: Council voted on 10 June 2026 to collect the red/dark-green rubbish bin every two weeks. Standard bin grows from 80 L to 140 L (80 L up to 2 × 240 L available). FOGO stays weekly, recycling fortnightly, glass every four weeks. Bigger bins at no cost for eligible households, such as 2+ kids in nappies or larger households.
projects.when: Information mailed late Jan–early Feb 2027. Confirm your bin size in Feb 2027. New bins Mar–Jun 2027. Fortnightly pickups start Jul–Oct 2027.
projects.why: Affects every household on Ryan St. Pick a bin size in February 2027; 140 L is the default.

decision.text: Council voted for fortnightly rubbish collection from July 2027

projects.name: General Local Law review
projects.what: Rewrite of the rules council enforces: animals, property amenity, building sites, vehicles on council land, waste and recycling, fire safety, smoking and alcohol. Draft law, building works code and a side-by-side comparison with the 2018 law are up.
projects.when: Council adoption February 2027.
projects.why: Covers pets, building-site rules for neighbours' works and bins, so it shapes everyday life on the street.

decision.text: New Local Law to Council for adoption (Feb 2027)

projects.name: Council Budget 2026–2030
projects.what: $259.6M budget with $91.5M of capital works in 2026–27. Includes detailed design of the $60M new Coburg library and piazza, plus $145k for a community-voted risky playground at ATC Reserve, Glenroy, and $80k for more playground shade.
projects.when: Coburg library construction targeted for mid-2028.
projects.why: The new library and piazza is 0.9 km from home and will reshape central Coburg.

decision.text: Council adopted the 2026-2030 budget, including design of the Coburg library

projects.name: Power-pole EV charging trial
projects.what: Eight on-street chargers mounted on power poles (22 kW, two cars each), run by Intellihub and EVX at roughly 40–70c/kWh based on NSW pricing. Sites are on the project page map.
projects.when: Installed and operating Jun 2026 – Sep 2028.

decision.text: Council approved eight power-pole EV chargers

projects.name: Sale of laneway land behind 436–442 Sydney Rd
projects.what: 84 m² former road strip behind four Sydney Rd shops, to be sold to the shops' owner.
projects.when: Submissions closed 21 Apr 2026; goes to a future Council meeting.

projects.name: Fawkner–Coburg North boundary tweak
projects.what: Minor realignment so properties accessed from Coburg North streets (near Mathieson St and Queens Pde) are addressed to Coburg North. No other addresses change.
projects.when: Subject to Council approval.

projects.name: Places for People plan
projects.what: Ten-year plan for new and upgraded public spaces around shopping strips. Current projects include Post Office Place (Glenroy), West Street, and a new park at 568 Sydney Road.
projects.when: Delivery 2026–2036.

decision.text: Council adopted the Places for People plan (June 2026)

projects.name: Rates hardship policy
projects.what: Updated policy for ratepayers in financial hardship, extended to commercial, non-primary-residence and vacant land, with more flexible payment plans.
projects.when: Consulted April–May 2026.

projects.name: How council shares information
projects.what: Review of the Accessible and Inclusive Communications and Community Engagement policies: plain English, translations, website, and how consultation results are reported back.
projects.when: Consulted from March 2026.

projects.name: Fawkner Ramadan/Eid event EOI
projects.what: Expressions of interest from community groups to run a council-funded Ramadan or Eid event in Fawkner, Feb–Mar 2027.
projects.when: Applicants notified by 19 Oct; agreement in place Nov 2026.

projects.name: Central Coburg framework
projects.sub: Victoria St, Louisa St and Harding St area
projects.what: Council's plan for central Coburg: a new $60M library and piazza, around 1,000 new homes (market, affordable and social), new office and retail space, six new green spaces, about 200 trees and around 900 public car parks.
projects.when: Delivered in stages; library construction from April 2028.
projects.why: About 1 km from home; the biggest change to central Coburg in decades.

decision.text: Council endorsed the Central Coburg framework

projects.name: New Coburg Library and Piazza
projects.what: $60M new library and public piazza in central Coburg. Winning design chosen February 2026 after a design competition; community feedback on the draft concept ran March to April 2026.
projects.when: Construction begins April 2028; opens November 2029.
projects.why: Under 1 km away; a new library and square for the kids.

projects.name: Harding-Munro Street improvements
projects.what: Redesign of the Harding Street and Munro Street corridor through central Coburg. Concept designs went out for comment in September 2026.
projects.when: Preferred design Dec 2026 to mid 2027, to Council late 2027 or early 2028, construction 2027-2028 (to be confirmed).
projects.why: A main route around central Coburg, about 1 km away.

projects.name: Louisa Street upgrade
projects.what: Permanent redesign to make Louisa Street safer and easier to walk, following a temporary footpath trial (2023) and car park upgrade (2024).
projects.when: Preliminary design to June 2027; consultation to be confirmed; construction within 2026-2028.

projects.name: Barrow Street trial road closure
projects.sub: Barrow St at Harding St, Coburg
projects.what: Trial closure of Barrow Street at the Harding Street intersection, extended for a further 12 months.
projects.when: Decision on the trial's future early to mid 2027.

decision.text: Decision on the Barrow St trial closure (early to mid 2027)

projects.name: Harding Street Bridge replacement
projects.what: Replacing the narrow 1985 timber suspension bridge over the Merri Creek with a wider, safer walking and cycling bridge, jointly with Darebin Council. Community suggested names earlier in 2026.
projects.when: Design adjustments and a public vote on the name are next; construction dates not yet published.
projects.why: On the Merri Creek trail used for walks and bike rides.

projects.name: The Avenue: 275 homes and new park
projects.sub: Former Kangan Batman TAFE site, Coburg
projects.what: Development Victoria is building four apartment buildings with up to 275 homes (10% affordable, one build-to-rent) on the former TAFE site, plus a new park made from part of The Avenue at De Carle Street.
projects.when: Park naming August 2027; park construction from November 2027.

projects.name: New park at 568 Sydney Road, Brunswick
projects.sub: Brunswick, next to Staley St car park
projects.what: A new 1,550 m² local park on Council land and part of the Staley Street car park, under the Places for People plan. Draft design consultation closed September 2026.
projects.when: Final design January 2027; construction mid 2027 to mid 2028.

projects.name: Coburg health and community services precinct
projects.what: Council-sold land on Bell Street being developed by Coburg Health Hub as a precinct for GPs, aged care, childcare, dental and allied health. The development application is with Council.
projects.when: Decision on the planning application in 2026.
projects.why: More GPs, childcare and dental close to home.

decision.text: Decision on Coburg health precinct planning application (2026)

projects.name: State activity centre plan for Coburg
projects.status: State plan; check if in force
projects.what: Part of the state's Train and Tram Zone Activity Centres. Core near Coburg station: 6 to 16 storeys. Inner catchment (about 800 m, a 10-minute walk): up to 4 storeys, or 6 on blocks over 1,000 m². Outer catchment: up to 3 storeys, or 4 on large blocks. Includes sun protection for Victoria St, Sydney Rd, Bridges Reserve and City Oval.
projects.when: Page last updated 31 Mar 2026; check the state map for your block and whether controls are in force.
projects.why: Ryan St is about 800 m from the station, at the edge of the catchment.

projects.name: Place of worship, 13 Dawson St
projects.what: Planning application to use the land as a place of worship, with 5 fewer car parks than the standard requirement.
projects.when: Lodged about 22 Oct 2026.
projects.why: 0.7 km away; parking and traffic on nearby streets.

projects.name: Shop, 947A Sydney Rd
projects.what: Planning application to use the land as a shop, with business signage. The site is in a Public Acquisition Overlay (land reserved for a future public project).
projects.when: Lodged about Sep 2026.

projects.name: Eight dwellings, 32 Bell St
projects.what: Planning application for eight dwellings on one lot, a changed driveway onto Bell St (Transport Zone 2) and removal of boundary canopy trees.
projects.when: Lodged about Sep 2026.
projects.why: The largest recent housing application within 1.5 km.

projects.name: Five dwellings, 39 Surrey St
projects.what: Planning application for five double-storey dwellings.
projects.when: Lodged about 17 Oct 2026.

projects.name: Works to place of worship, 118-122 Nicholson St
projects.what: Planning application for building works to an existing place of worship in a Special Building Overlay (flood-prone land).
projects.when: Lodged about Sep 2026.

projects.name: School works, 71 Grandview Ave
projects.what: Planning application for a new school entry and student amenities block on Waverley Parade and a new chapel building.
projects.when: Lodged about Sep 2026.

projects.name: Venue with liquor, 85 Sydney Rd
projects.what: Planning application to use the land as a place of assembly with sale and consumption of liquor.
projects.when: Lodged about 21 Oct 2026.

projects.name: Bin strike north of Bell St
projects.what: Union (ASU) industrial action: crews intend to miss every 5th household bin north of Bell Street. South of Bell St is run by a contractor and not affected. If your bin isn't collected, leave it out.
projects.when: Started 2 Nov 2026; catch-up run Sat 7 Nov; action ongoing.
projects.why: Ryan St is north of Bell St, so we're affected.

projects.name: Upfield line: duplication pledge and crossing delays
projects.what: The state has committed to duplicating the Upfield line between Gowrie and Upfield. Council says the eight Brunswick level crossing removals have slipped from 2027 to 2030 and now 2033.
projects.when: No construction dates yet.
projects.why: Our train line; more services if duplication goes ahead.

projects.name: Amendment C235: developer levy for parks
projects.what: Planning scheme change raising the open space levy developers pay when land is subdivided, to fund new and better parks. Not a change to council rates.
projects.when: Submissions closed 30 Oct 2026; council is assessing them (state register, 30 Oct).

decision.text: C235 developer levy goes to a planning panel

projects.name: Central Coburg traders' special charge 2027-2032
projects.what: Proposed levy on commercial properties in the Central Coburg Shopping Precinct to fund the Central Coburg Business Association's marketing and promotion. Not charged to homes.
projects.when: Council to decide 14 Apr 2027.

decision.text: Council to declare the Central Coburg traders' charge

projects.name: H5 bird flu detected in Merri-bek
projects.what: H5 bird flu found in a single wild seabird at a private property in Oak Park. Risk to people is low. Don't feed wild birds, and don't touch sick or dead birds; keep kids and pets away and report them.
projects.when: Updated 7 Oct 2026.

projects.name: Amendment C233: planning scheme and heritage review
projects.status: Open for submissions, closes Sun 29 Nov
projects.what: Big update to Merri-bek's planning rules: trims and consolidates the Heritage Overlay, removes some design and development overlays (DDO1, DDO7, DDO9), updates the Coburg Activity Centre Zone schedule, and rezones public parkland. Check whether your property's heritage or overlay status changes.
projects.when: On exhibition 29 Oct to 29 Nov 2026; submissions then go to council.

decision.text: Council considers submissions on C233 (heritage and planning scheme review)

projects.name: Amendment C236: development contributions for every new build
projects.what: Introduces a council-wide Development Contributions Plan, so new developments anywhere in Merri-bek pay a levy towards local infrastructure. Applies to all land in the municipality.
projects.when: Exhibited May to June 2026; independent panel appointed Sep 2026, hearing and report next.

decision.text: Panel report on C236 development contributions, then council decision

projects.name: Childcare centre, 742 Sydney Rd
projects.what: New childcare centre on Sydney Rd, Coburg North, with business signage and a change to road access. The closest larger application to Ryan St (about 400 m).
projects.when: Lodged with council 26 Aug 2026. Check PlanningAlerts for the notice period and how to object.

projects.when: Lodged with council 16 Oct 2026. Check PlanningAlerts for the notice period and how to object.

projects.when: Lodged with council 7 Aug 2026. Check PlanningAlerts for the notice period and how to object.

projects.when: Lodged with council 26 Jun 2026. Check PlanningAlerts for the notice period and how to object.

projects.what: New car wash with signage and an electronic pole sign, in the Public Acquisition Overlay (land reserved for future road works).
projects.when: Lodged with council 22 Aug 2026. Check PlanningAlerts for the notice period and how to object.

projects.what: Use of the land as an indoor recreation facility (martial arts).
projects.when: Lodged with council 29 Aug 2026. Check PlanningAlerts for the notice period and how to object.

projects.what: Indoor recreation facility (martial arts studio) with an illuminated sign.
projects.when: Lodged with council 12 Jun 2026. Check PlanningAlerts for the notice period and how to object.

projects.what: Indoor ice hockey training facility in an existing unit, with rooftop works.
projects.when: Lodged with council 17 Jul 2026. Check PlanningAlerts for the notice period and how to object.

summary: Last call: feedback on the aquatics and leisure plan closes Wednesday 11 Nov, and the draft Local Law (pets, building sites, bins) closes Thursday 12 Nov.
Bins: the council workers' strike north of Bell St is ongoing, with crews missing about one bin in five, so leave a missed bin out until it is collected.
School run: Blair St precinct pop-ups at Merri-bek Primary on Thursday 19 Nov (3-6pm) and Friday 20 Nov (7:30-9:30am), with feedback open until Wednesday 2 Dec.
Coming up: draft park plans for Tony Mommsen and Hallam reserves are due this month, and the Coburg Night Market returns to Bridges Reserve from Thursday 17 to Saturday 19 Dec.
Planning: no new large applications near Ryan St this week, and heritage and planning rule changes (Amendment C233) are open for submissions until Sunday 29 Nov.
